title: pr-439210-onboard-aurora-pro-lite-3b-v1.1-performance-metadata-perf-profiles-changelog-automation
author: Samir Patel
description: Onboard Aurora Pro Lite 3B v1.1: add metadata, calibrated performance profiles, and wire up changelog/release-notes automation. Motivation: Aurora Pro Lite 3B is a promising low-latency variant we want available in the public model catalog. This PR includes model metadata (hyperparams, tokenizer, weights provenance), runtime performance profiles generated from bench runs, a conservative quantization recommendation, and automation to surface a changelog entry when model metadata or profiles change. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata YAML - [x] Add perf profile JSON (latency/throughput/seq distribution) - [x] Add quickstart example in docs - [x] Add unit and bench tests - [x] Add changelog generation hook to registry CI - [x] Update catalog index - [ ] Follow-up: add larger-scale perf sweep for long-seq scenarios. Changes in brief: added models/aurora-pro-lite/metadata.yaml, perf/profiles/aurora-pro-lite-3b-v1.1.json, docs/models/aurora-pro-lite.md, ci/workflows/model-registry.yml (hook), tools/changelog-gen.py (adds automated release notes entry when metadata or perf profile changes). See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and validation criteria. This description is intentionally a single continuous string per repo guidelines.

release_notes: Add Aurora Pro Lite 3B v1.1 to model catalog with metadata and verified perf profiles
Perf highlights: median token latency 12.6ms (seq=256) on g4dn.xlarge-equivalent; 1.8k tokens/sec throughput for batch=8 at seq=1024
Quantization recommendation: int8 quantization validated for latency-sensitive workloads; use fp16 for max quality
Automation: changelog entry created automatically when model metadata or perf profiles change (CI hook)
